modes.current: AlphaI-green required, anti-chase, pullback bonus, conviction sizing, adaptive AlphaI exits (live sleeve).
modes.max_mover_hold: No AlphaI. Buy highest 24h return in pool (volume floor only). Hold until trail/stop/time. Same book/clip/1-slot.
modes.max_mover_rotate: Same entry as max_mover_hold, but rotate into a stronger 24h mover when flat/weak and gap ≥ 2pp after 3h.

caveat: Long-only: cannot short the biggest down-movers. AlphaI board for 'current' is one snapshot projected over the window. Mover modes use live candle returns each decision bar.
